Hi Elena — thanks for the clear ask. Attaching a draft MAP and a short note on the GCP private-offer flow. High level below; full details are in the attached spreadsheet and the Redwood MAP PDF.

Draft MAP highlights (summary):
1) Eval kickoff (week 0): 2027-05-09 — dev + platform teams onboarded, sample dataset loaded, baseline smoke tests run.
2) Week 1-2: Performance ramping — run 50k tokens/day (target) with prefix caching enabled; collect p95 latency and token cost metrics.
3) Week 3-4: Acceptance gating — run defined acceptance prompts (see sheet) and pass quality/regression checks; security questionnaire answers submitted.
4) Week 5: Procurement steps — Redwood prepares GCP private-offer activation; Galacto to approve PO and provide billing contact.
5) Week 6: Sign-off and transition to Dedicated quotas or hosted plan per agreed SKU.

GCP private-offer / billing notes:
- Marketplace private offer is the preferred route for billing to a PO; GCP issues invoices per their marketplace terms. Redwood will provision the private offer and coordinate activation.
- If the customer requires Redwood-issued invoices, we can do a passthrough invoice but that requires procurement exception and Redwood finance approval (add ~3 business days).

Action items:
- Elena: share Procurement billing contact + desired PO number format
- Jordan (cc): can you confirm typical timeline for passthrough invoices if Proc requests Redwood invoice instead of GCP?
- Kimberly (cc): please review the attached MAP for any legal points that should be surfaced early (indemnity, data residency notes).

Attachments: galactobiolabs_mpa_draft.xlsx (MAP draft), redwood_mpa_template.pdf (one-pager)

Proposed next step: 30-min sync with procurement + legal next week (I’m available Tue/Wed afternoon PT).

Thanks — Vivek

Tom / Elena — quick answers and a concrete next-step plan.

1) Usage detail: yes — Redwood will deliver a monthly usage CSV with per-route token breakout, p50/p95 latency, and cost attribution. We can do automated delivery to your billing mailbox or push to a shared Drive link. (Jordan: please prepare sample CSV template.)

2) Activation flow: private-offer activation is initiated by Redwood and then requires the customer to accept the offer in GCP Marketplace (a single-click acceptance in the GCP Console). We can schedule a walkthrough and stay on the line while you accept. Average lead time: 1–3 business days after we provision the offer; in practice allow 3–5 business days to coordinate internal approvals.

3) Signatory & legal loop: Redwood legal will be the signatory; Kimberly will own the contract redline loop. Kimberly — our standard order form owner will respond to redlines; please flag anything non-standard.

Earliest activation target: if we provision the private offer by 2027-05-10, you should be able to accept in the console by 2027-05-12 and start the eval on 2027-05-13 (slightly earlier than the target you gave). If Procurement insists on Redwood invoicing (passthrough), allow an extra 3 business days for finance approval.

Next steps (actionable):
- Vivek: will send HubSpot deal + DocuSign envelope for the order form (expect by EOD 2027-05-09).
- Elena: please provide PO contact and any required PO number format.
- Jordan: prepare example usage CSV and confirm passthrough invoice SLA if requested.
- Kimberly: stand by to receive contract redlines; legal contact is kimberly_park@redwood.com.

I’m copying internal owners so we can close the loop quickly. Suggest 30-min procurement kick-off on 2027-05-11 at 10:00 AM PT — open to reschedule.

Regards,
Vivek
